soc.knockout_cagey_factor.rationale: Cup knockouts reduce goals and favourite win rates, and the effect varies by round, tie format and leg; a league-fitted goal and draw rate misprices the goalless leg and the race window of first-scorer contracts in cup ties and the regulation/extra-time/shootout split of method-of-finish or method-of-victory contracts.

soc.extra_time_phase_scoring_rate.rationale: Goal intensity in extra time is not a pro-rata share of the 90-minute rate, and that matters in two contract families: method-of-finish/victory contracts split level-at-90 mass between extra time and penalties by it, and first-team-to-score contracts need it for the 91-120 part of the race window and the no-goal leg. Pro-rating lambda_90 by 30/90 overstates ET goals; the discount depends on remaining substitutes and bench quality, which differ between the two sides.

soc.second_leg_aggregate_state.measurement: Compute aggregate deficit/lead before the leg, who advances at 90/120 minutes under the rules, and a probability of extra time; adjust goal-rate multipliers by required goals from historical second legs by deficit. Output is the goal-rate multipliers and P(extra time) only; the P(advance) composition from those outputs and the competition rule table lives in soc.tie_advancement_state_tree and is not restated here.
